tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient rows decisively reveal a strong sink-dependent decline and a negative response at the largest input. Fit both supplied negative branch forms against the gradient-modulated siphon base using numerical least squares, selecting the lower-residual fit; no further probe is needed before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight available observations span both the positive concave regime and the high-gradient downturn; buying a trajectory is unnecessary for fitting the supplied static siphon candidates.
All observations share H and x_now, so the ODE parameters are not identifiable from these data and the observed sink-gradient dependence directly favors the supplied static mechanism.
It ignores s_grad and cannot account for the observed downturn and sign crossing.
